_comment: Curated candidate sources for discovery.yml. Public, legal, API-documented platforms only. Adding a source = a reviewed commit changing this file; discovery never adds sources at runtime. Pirated-content sites are never added. contentTypes must stay inside the SalooRepo allowlist (movie, series, anime, cartoon, documentary); discovery.yml rejects candidates that violate the content policy (step S6c).
